lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Nd2O8 (reduced formula Ca2NdO4) is orthorhombic, space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Nd centers as octahedrally coordinated by six O atoms, while Ca centers show four O neighbors; O environments vary from four- to five-coordinate. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Nd octahedra sharing corners and edges with one another, and corner-sharing between Ca and Nd polyhedra.
